export.protoMessageConflict: Cannot export as Protocol Buffers: the message name {message} is also generated by the table {other} (rename one of the tables)
export.protoFieldConflict: Cannot export as Protocol Buffers: the columns {field} and {other} have the same JSON name (rename one of the columns)
export.protoInvalidName: Cannot export as Protocol Buffers: the name {name} does not make a valid Protocol Buffers name ({proto}) (use a name that starts with a lowercase letter and has only lowercase letters, digits and _)
export.invalidVersion: The version to export, {value}, is not in semantic versioning format (e.g. 1.2.3)
export.invalidRecordVersion: The version value {value} is not in semantic versioning format (e.g. 1.2.3), so it cannot be compared when exporting a specific version (this record is not exported)
